Why cotton textiles grew in Maharashtra and Gujarat: the five location factors, Class 10 Geography, Manufacturing Industries, explained.

• From handloom to India's first successful textile mill: Mumbai, 1854
• Five reasons: raw cotton, markets, transport (including ports), labour and a moist climate
• Today: spinning is centralised in Maharashtra, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu, weaving is highly decentralised
